notes: The second and third groups are the remark «رفع هشام الدستوائي هذا الحديث عن قتادة وأوقفه سعيد بن أبي عروبة عن قتادة ولم يرفعه»: a variant report that another chain carried the saying differently (raised or stopped). Rule 11 case, so needs_ruling.
«أبي» (occurrence 1) is the father of معاذ, a bare relation; «أبيه» is the father of أبي حرب, also a bare relation.
«قال قتادة وهذا ما لم يطعما» is a commentary by Qatada, not a link; the Prophet is the end of the chain.
